title: Stop an active livestream before destroying it
description: Spec jmap-chat-spec 6bcd9d8 draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md L1274: "`destroy` removes the VTCLivestream metadata. If the livestream is in state \"starting\" or \"live\", the server first stops it, so that no orphaned stream keeps running after the metadata is removed." Code: crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/media.rs destroy_media destroys a starting/live VTCLivestream without the stop patch (state stopped, stoppedAt). Found while implementing JMAP-0x0q.35 (recording counterpart).
